reddit.title: Introducing Detailed Material Tracking for Your Builds
reddit.body: We're excited to announce a significant update to how you manage resources in Provincia! Instead of a single cost chip, each build tile now displays a detailed materials sheet. This new feature allows you to see exactly what materials you have stored versus what you need, with any shortages clearly highlighted. No more guessing—just straightforward resource management! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Enhanced Resource Management in Provincia!
steam.body: We're thrilled to introduce a new feature that changes how you manage resources while building. Instead of a single cost badge, each build tile now presents a materials sheet that clearly lists what you have and what you need. This update aims to streamline your building process and make resource management more intuitive. For a detailed overview of this feature, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
